newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide 1996 audited net 763 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide 1996 audited net 763 mln pesos.

text.p: Uniwide Holdings Inc posted an audited net of 763 million pesos in 1996 from the previous year's 111.6 million, chief financial officer Jaime Cabangis told Reuters on Thursday.
Cabangis said Uniwide's net income in 1996 includes 28 million pesos in insurance recovery from its department store in Cubao, Quezon City which was destroyed in a fire.
"But even if you remove the non-recurring cost our net income is still slightly higher than our forecast of 731 million pesos," he said.
Cabangis attributed the robust growth in his company's net income to increases in franchise fees, rental income from its malls and sale of residential and commercial lots.
